lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately six horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits. The highest concentration of local maxima is located in the mid-flank region where spots are roughly equidistant.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated luminance that align with the vertical columns of spots, creating a rectilinear grid of anchor nodes across the central lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from a light upper edge to a dark shadowed lower edge, extending from the branchial region toward the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs, with approximately 8-12 distinct spots concentrated primarily toward the anterior leading edge and mid-surface of the fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: The cranial region displays a high-density 'stardust' pattern consisting of significantly smaller, more numerous high-luminance points compared to the larger maculae on the lateral flank.
